summary: Hold merges of normative RFC changes until the RFC's declared review authorities reply (Morgan's RFC-0018 v0.4.1 sign-off condition)

options.description: Each RFC declares reviewAuthorities in frontmatter; cli-merge-if-eligible refuses any PR changing a declared RFC (fail closed on an unreadable base copy); the operator merges by hand after the authorities reply; planner opens RFC amendments as draft PRs until the gate lands
Refuse auto-merge for any change to an RFC whose lifecycle on main is past Draft
No code; the planner opens every normative RFC amendment as a draft PR
No new rule; rely on provisional markers and lifecycle demotion

body: Problem: the planner's own RFC PRs auto-merge in minutes through the docs lane (#2970 in 60s, #3088 in 4 min) before an affected outside authority reviews them; Design Authority (Morgan) conditioned the RFC-0018 v0.4.1 signature on later accessibility or success-metric changes coming back to Design before they merge. Authors akillies and mohirt are already off the reconcile allow-list, so their own PRs wait for a hand merge; this decision covers the planner and operator direction. Nothing in the merge path reads RFC lifecycle or sign-off rows today (merge-if-eligible.ts:384, docs-only-paths.mjs:15).
